about.headline: Engineering panels in Bengaluru since 2008.
story: We started building electrical panels in Bengaluru in 2008 as Venus Enterprises, and incorporated as Poweramps Technology Pvt. Ltd. in 2013. We design, manufacture and service power, distribution and instrumentation panels for building, industrial and commercial customers: motor control centres (MCC), power control centres (PCC), DG AMF and synchronizing panels, capacitor and APFC panels, metering panels, AC drive (VFD) and soft-starter panels, PLC panels, bus ducts, AC and DC distribution boards and custom-built instrumentation panels.

Our R&D centre at Malagala, Vijayanagar designs electronics and instrumentation in-house, including AMF logic control relays, battery chargers, earth leakage relays (ELR), earth fault relays (EFR) and instrumentation controllers. We also handle earthing design, bus duct design and installation, and automation and SCADA instrumentation.

Led by directors K. V. Venkatachalapathi and V. Rajashekar, with technical advisers T. Venkatesh and Muniraj, our team combines in-house design, fabrication and testing with installation and maintenance. Our quality policy: reliability, performance and customer satisfaction.
